component.name: Messages (Rust Preview)
component.summary: Native Pantheon conversation client for BlueFerry

description.p: A Rust, GTK 4 and Granite client for the existing BlueFerry Messages API. BlueFerry remains responsible for the iPhone MAP session, recipient validation and encrypted history.

This preview includes conversation search, message history, local drafts, favorites, read state, checked replies and explicit group participant confirmation. It is not yet a feature-parity replacement for the current Messages app.
Initial native Rust preview; parity and owner phone qualification remain open.
